title: Release notes · AviQuiz
heading: Release notes
overview: What is new in AviQuiz, newest version first. Release dates record when a release is packaged and tagged, and remain the same in staging and production.
alpha02Intro: This alpha expands seasonal practice across Colombia, adds Spanish, and brings optional account-based statistics to AviQuiz.
alpha02Languages: English and Colombian Spanish interfaces, with a language selector and localized labels, help, dialogs, and application messages.
alpha02Colombia: Colombia-wide seasonal species coverage, with quizzes for the country, departments, and supported sites. Photo quizzes include species with available photos; coverage continues to expand.
alpha02Photos: Photo selection prefers the quarters in your seasonal window: January–March, April–June, July–September, and October–December. Windows spanning quarters can use either; other photo dates are used when matching photos are unavailable.
alpha02Statistics: Optional signed-in statistics across devices, cumulative identification history and latest-result comparisons, browser-statistics consent, and import of older browser statistics. Guest quizzes remain available without an account.
alpha01Intro: The first public alpha brings visual and audio bird-identification practice to aviquiz.org.
alpha01Quizzes: Photo and audio quizzes with site and family filters, mistake review, and separate visual/audio progress.
alpha01Geography: North Carolina seasonal geography quizzes, alongside the original Colombia itinerary and practice material.
alpha01Accounts: Invitation-based accounts and guest quizzes open to everyone.
alpha02FixIntro: Includes all features and improvements from v0.2.0-alpha.1, plus consistent navigation across pages.
alpha02Navigation: Consistent header links to the quiz builder, practice, trips, and statistics across the site.
includedIn: All changes in this candidate are included in {{version}}.
alpha03Intro: This alpha improves geography quiz support and clarifies the release history. It includes all features and improvements from v0.2.0-alpha.2.
alpha03Geography: Geography quiz improvements to support expanding coverage, while preserving North Carolina and Colombia seasonal quizzes, family filters, photo credits, and seasonal photo selection.
alpha03History: Release notes list the newest versions first, clearly identify updates included from earlier candidates, and use a consistent release date.
alpha04Intro: Includes all features and improvements from v0.2.0-alpha.3, with a smoother quiz launch and improved desktop navigation.
alpha04Launch: Geography quizzes open directly into a dedicated quiz view, with a clear loading screen and retry controls. The home and Practice setup pages no longer flash before the quiz, and Take a quiz stays selected in the header.
alpha04Header: Improved desktop header spacing keeps the language selector on the same line in English and Spanish, including accounts with invitation access.
